resources.string: Plays the game with the Run Companion as a floating bubble on top. Tap the bubble to open it, tap × to go back to the game.
Step 1: allow \"Display over other apps\" for MS Companion.
Magic Survival is not installed. The bubble is running anyway.
Tap the bubble over the game to open it.
Fills in artifacts, talents and the Owned lists as you play. Android asks to share the screen each time; nothing leaves the phone.
